subject: Startups
title: The Option Pool Shuffle
description: A quick win: understand The Option Pool Shuffle.

hook.text: Before a funding round, VCs ask you to create a 10–15% option pool. Sounds reasonable—until you see who it dilutes.

buildup.text: The option pool is carved from pre-money valuation, meaning existing shareholders (founders) absorb all the dilution.

discovery.text: A $10M pre-money with a 15% option pool effectively means founders are valued at $8.5M, not $10M.

twist.text: VCs benefit twice: they avoid diluting themselves and they get a discounted entry. It's legal but aggressive.

climax.text: Founders can negotiate: smaller pool, post-money carve-out, or extending existing options. Don't accept the default.

punchline.text: The option pool shuffle is a hidden discount. Negotiate it.

quiz.question: Who bears the dilution from a pre-money option pool?
